resources.string: REPLAY — scripted adapter data, not a live scan
OFFLINE — no adapter or vehicle connection
LIVE — data read from a connected adapter
ADAPTER BENCH — adapter-only commands, never vehicle requests
A live read hasn\'t been opened yet. Open it to see, save or copy it, or discard it. Other sessions can\'t start until then.
LIVE READ — car codes only, no sensor readings or clearing

Reads the supported-reading map and stored and pending trouble codes from the car (0100, 03 and 07). It also sends the adapter setup commands ATE0, ATL0, ATH1 and ATSP0 (automatic protocol detection) first, and ATDPN after 0100 to report the protocol found. Detection usually takes a few seconds and is stopped after about a minute at most. It never requests live sensor readings or clears codes. Car parked, ignition on, engine off.
